correctness.rationale: Complete direct construction of all eligible words, equivalence to independent sets, exhaustive four-base clique census, a directly checked 27-strand code, and two full six-base 0-1 branch-and-bound programs (980 maximal-clique and 7804 edge rows) both terminate at integer and dual optimum 27. An explicit 136-strand eight-base construction passes all 9,180 unordered pair checks. Reproducible programs and witnesses are present. The solver upper bound is integer-separated from 28 and a material reproducibility dependency, not a bare log.

value.rationale: A motivated short-block design benchmark for exact 50% GC, maximal homopolymer length one, one-substitution correction and Watson-Crick separation. The sharp n=6 capacity 27 establishes a real five-bit capacity obstruction; a directly checkable n=8 code with 136 words resolves first feasibility for both five- and seven-bit payloads. The integer exactness and threshold distinction are useful independent of asymptotic results, but do not purport to be broad coding theorems.
